name: notebook-workbench
description: Create, inspect, and safely edit Jupyter notebook cells while keeping the notebook as the source of truth.

interface.shortDescription: Create and safely edit Jupyter notebook cells.
interface.longDescription: Provides a deterministic local CLI and Codex workflow for creating notebooks, inspecting notebook structure, editing cells by stable ID or tag, validating source notebooks, and extracting executed outputs.
defaultPrompt: List the cells and tags in this notebook.
Safely update a notebook cell by tag.
Inspect errors in this executed notebook.
